description: “The Secretary of State’s office belongs to the people of Indiana — not to political parties,” Shillings said in a news release. “Indiana doesn’t need a Secretary of State who treats the office as a political tool. We need someone who treats it as a public trust.”
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lauri for Liberty
title: Libertarians pick Indiana secretary of state candidate. — Lauri Shillings for Indiana Secretary of State
